einzeiler: Cat owners share chaotic and hilarious stories about their cats during house guests.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss the unique personalities and eccentric behaviors of their cats, particularly when having guests over. Listeners contribute funny stories about feline disasters during hosting events. The episode is sponsored by Arm & Hammer Cat Litter.
stichpunkte: Discussion on the distinct and often unpredictable personalities of cats compared to dogs
How cats react to visitors, ranging from avoidance to outright hostility
A listener story about a cat named Margarita disrupting a watch party and turning off the TV
A listener story involving a cat leaving a mess on the floor and a new romance
Stories of cats peeing or pooping on beds and guests out of territorial annoyance
A story about a cat named Pino holding a 33-year-old guest hostage at the top of the stairs
The shared bond of cat ownership and the chaos it brings
beschreibung: The Gigglers called in this week to share their craziest kitty faux paws while hosting. This bonus episode is brought to you by Arm & Hammer Cat Litter.
